scope: Exploratory subject-by-movement reformulation after prior aggregate p-values were inspected; not preregistered confirmation. Fixed before computing movement-level outcomes.
aggregation: Recompute Euclidean landmark distances from saved predictions and targets in float64. Average endpoints and landmarks, the two windows within subject/task/seed, then the three seed errors (never average predictions). Equal weights for all eight tasks and nine participants.
cell_definition: Subject by recorded movement-task type; window is not an independently segmented movement repetition.

gap_contrasts.label: TCN (matched) token−feature gap versus proposed
gap_contrasts.effect_direction: Other decoder token-minus-feature error gap minus proposed gap (mm); positive indicates a smaller tokenization penalty for proposed.

gap_contrasts.label: Transformer (matched) token−feature gap versus proposed
gap_contrasts.effect_direction: Other decoder token-minus-feature error gap minus proposed gap (mm); positive indicates a smaller tokenization penalty for proposed.

gap_contrasts.label: Qwen3 (pretrained) token−feature gap versus proposed
gap_contrasts.effect_direction: Other decoder token-minus-feature error gap minus proposed gap (mm); positive indicates a smaller tokenization penalty for proposed.

model.response: Other decoder (token minus feature error) minus proposed (token minus feature error), within the same subject and task.
model.fixed_effects: Eight task-specific means, fitted by ordinary least squares without an extra intercept.
model.dependence: Arbitrary covariance across the eight task cells within each participant; participants independent. Model concerns these fixed eight tasks.
model.estimand: mu = c^T beta, c=(1/8,...,1/8), equal-task mean contrast.
model.standard_error: sqrt(c^T V c). This equals sample SD of the nine participant marginal contrasts divided by sqrt(9).
model.null: c^T beta = 0; individual movement-specific effects need not equal zero.
model.method_name: Balanced repeated-measures model with fixed movement effects and participant-cluster covariance; not a mixed-effects model.

inference.method: Exact two-sided synchronized participant sign-flip single-step max-|t|
inference.implementation: For each participant sign pattern multiply all eight movement cells together, refit beta and the cluster covariance, compute the equal-task marginal t, and combine the three C t statistics with the existing 48 t statistics in the same maximum reference distribution.
inference.exactness: Follows from reduction to participant marginal contrasts and their joint true-null central sign symmetry. Do not claim a generic nuisance-adjusted permutation regression; arbitrary covariance alone does not establish exactness.
inference.assumptions: Independent participants and jointly centrally symmetric true-null participant-marginal contrast vectors. This cannot be established with nine participants. No cell-wise flips, no asymptotic cluster Wald p-values, and no task-wise hypothesis tests.
inference.expected_equivalence: With complete balanced data the marginal t equals the prior participant-mean t under every sign pattern. Rescoring float32 predictions in float64 can cause small numerical differences; record and report these, never force equality by changing cells.
inference.intervals: Existing pointwise sign-flip location-interval method on the reconstructed participant marginal contrasts, reported in table only.

display: Replace C with four token-feature gap distributions of all 72 correlated subject-by-task cells per decoder, equally weighted red overall mean, and existing three other-minus-proposed comparisons. Use distinct cell marker and caption/legend so A participant dots remain unambiguous. Retain all data with honest axis/outlier treatment.

review_before_movement_outcomes.result: Pass with clarified marginal-null symmetry, fixed-task scope, nine independent participants, explicit precision audit and unambiguous C marker legend.
